alloy.definition:
n. a mixture containing two or more metallic elements or metallic and nonmetallic elements usually fused together or dissolving into each other when molten
v. make an alloy of
alloy.translation:
n. 合金
vt. 将...铸成合金, 减低成色
vi. 合铸

alloy iron.translation: [机] 合金铸铁, 合金铁

alloyage.definition:
n. The act or art of alloying metals; also, the combination
   or alloy.

alloyd oil.translation: [机] 掺合油, 添加植物或动物油的润滑油

alloyed.translation:
a. [材] 合金的；合铸的；熔合的
v. 将…铸成合金；使低劣（alloy的过去分词）

alloyed oil.translation: [化] 掺合油(添加植物或动物油的润滑油,具有良好油性)

alloying.definition:
v lower in value by increasing the base-metal content
v make an alloy of
alloying.translation: 炼制合金, 加入合金成分
